body.cap: UNIUNI’s Presentation Underway at CES 2025 Pangyo Lunch Talk | Image by AVING News

body.x: UNIUNI (CEO Sooyeon Han) participated in the ‘CES 2025 Pangyo Lunch Talk’ held on February 20 at the Gyeonggi Startup Campus in Pangyo Techno Valley. The event aimed to showcase the innovative technologies of Pangyo-based companies that attended CES 2025, providing a platform for sharing industry trends and expanding global business opportunities.

UNIUNI shared insights into its technological innovations and experience during the event, winning the CES Innovation Award. The company is dedicated to “safety and privacy protection,” developing solutions that enhance the security and independence of various users, including individuals with disabilities, through anonymized data technology.

At CES 2025, UNIUNI introduced the ‘SAVVY Accessible Restroom,’ setting a new standard for smart security technology. This solution utilizes deep learning to detect abnormal behavior patterns in public restrooms in real time, sending immediate alerts in case of emergencies. The system employs anonymized Time-of-Flight (ToF) technology, ensuring precise monitoring while maintaining user privacy. UNIUNI’s’ technological prowess is demonstrated by its impressive performance metrics: 97.2% accuracy, 98.84% recall, and an F1 score of 98.01%. Recognizing this innovation, UNIUNI won the CES Innovation Awards 2025 Honoree in the Smart Cities category.

body.cap: Daria Kolotikhina, UNIUNI’s Global Communications Manager, speaking at the presentation | Image by AVING News

body.x: Daria Kolotikhina, UNIUNI’s Global Communications Manager, expressed gratitude for the award, stating, “This achievement reflects the dedicated efforts of our team and the continuous support from our partners. Our goal extends beyond technological development; we aim to create an environment where all users can experience safety and dignity. This recognition motivates us to expand further in the global market.”

Pangyo Techno Valley is a global R&D hub that integrates Research (R), People (P), Information (I), and Trade (T) across the IT, BT, CT, NT, and mobility sectors. It is a leading innovation cluster in Gyeonggi-do, established to drive technological innovation, talent development, job creation, and international business competitiveness.

The Gyeonggido Business and Science Accelerator’s Techno Valley Innovation Headquarters has continuously promoted Pangyo Techno Valley’s value by hosting events such as the Pangyo Evening Meet-Up, Pan-Pan Day, and Pangyo Startup Investment Exchange In-Best Pangyo. These initiatives have facilitated networking between Pangyo companies, domestic and international investors, and the media. Similar events are planned for this year to support the growth and global expansion of Pangyo startups through various assistance programs.
